verdict.rationale: Docs show substantial API/CLI parity: rules can be adjusted 'from the dashboard or API' (docs-41), dynamic routing can be configured via visual UI or JSON/API (docs-11), and a public openapi.json exists (probe-3), plus header-based controls (cf-aig-* headers) and a patchLog API for feedback. However, there's no explicit statement that *all* UI capabilities (e.g., full dashboard analytics views, DLP profile management, visual routing builder) are mirrored 1:1 via API, so full parity isn't confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of complete UI/API feature parity, independent/hands-on verification that dashboard-only features (e.g., visual route builder outputs) are fully API-accessible.
